title: Coop Mod For Prototype 1
author: Competitive-Budget40
selftext:
Just got basic character sync working for my co-op project!

Hey everyone! I’m working on Prototype 1 of a co-op mod/game using a framework built from decompiled code. It’s still very early, but I finally managed to get basic character movement and positions synced up between players.(claude+lua injection) Its purely for fun and literally nothing else

Crowds and enemies aren't synced yet (they're still doing their own thing on each screen), but getting the main player sync down feels like a huge milestone. Let me know what you think!

also feel free to support me \[https://buymeacoffee.com/justinkrase\](https://buymeacoffee.com/justinkrase) so i can get this out faster for yall ,ill flick more updates when im not working my freaking 9 to 5 . Peaceee
